pick.headline: Algiers Accords signed to free US hostages
pick.summary: On January 19, 1981, the United States and Iran, through Algerian mediation, signed the Algiers Accords providing for the release of the American hostages and the unfreezing of Iranian assets.
pick.significance: The agreement ended fourteen months of negotiations over the hostages seized at the US Embassy in Tehran.
pick.fbis: The Middle East and South Asia Review of January 19, 1981, led with the hostages: Algiers radio announced agreement after Warren Christopher signed the Algerian statement, while Iran's Behzad Nabavi stressed on Tehran radio that Iran had signed nothing with the United States, only with Algeria.
